title: Istanbul · Black Sea Forest and Şile Coast
slogan: A 376 km loop out of Polonezköy forest
story: Forest, Black Sea air and an early-start escape. Out of Mahmut Şevket Paşa and back again: 376 km, roughly 6 h 28 in the saddle. On the way it passes Şile coast, Ağva river and back through Şile coast. It keeps close to the shore for long stretches.

sections.advice: Istanbul start → Polonezköy forest is the reward section in Istanbul. Look through the bends, use legal pull-offs for photos and keep a little margin for tractors, cyclists and damp shade. The best ride here is smooth, not noisy.

Use Şile coast → Ağva river food as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

sections.advice: This Ağva river food → Riva return stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Şile Black Sea Coast
scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 70 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

storyWas: Forest, Black Sea air and an early-start escape.
